newsitem.title: BRAZIL: MOTOR RACING-COULTHARD SAYS HE CAN'T WIN AGAIN.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-COULTHARD SAYS HE CAN'T WIN AGAIN.

text.p: David Coulthard celebrated his 26th birthday on a cautious note by predicting he could not repeat his season-opening victory in Melbourne in Sunday's Brazilian Grand Prix.
"My target is to try to finish in the points again, if I can," he said on Thursday. "And that is realistic.
"You only have to see how well the Williams qualified in Melbourne to realise that they are a class ahead of the rest of us -- so long as they stay on the road.
"And you can't expect them to drop out every race like that so it is obviously going to be much more difficult."
Coulthard, who flew into sweltering Sao Paulo after a three-day holiday on a tropical island up the coast, hopes he can score well enough to hang on to his lead in the world drivers' champioship.
"That would be nice," he said. "To be in the points in every race is my realistic target this year."
